edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: IPT is well matched to postpartum depression because role transition, social support, and relationship stress are central maintaining factors.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2026 Uncu meta analysis in J Psychiatr Res, which suggests that interpersonal psychotherapy tracks with lower risk or better outcomes for postpartum depression. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
